title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 276 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 276 - Penalty for Non-compliance of Section 235 Where any person fails to comply with any notice or summons under section 235, the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes may impose a fine not exceeding 1% (one percent) of the value of each international transaction carried out by the person on such person.
